about: Numbers for the panels added on the refresh of 2026-11-14 (afternoon). Each item carries the text it was copied from ('quote') and where that text is ('src'). collect.py checks that every quote occurs, whitespace aside, in research/NOTEBOOK.md or research/CLAIMS.md, and that every number in 'value' occurs in its quote. NB = research/NOTEBOOK.md; dates are entry dates.
